programme.title: The Hidden Kingdoms Of China: Compilation T1 - Ep. 2
programme.desc: In this special episode, follow the rare and deadly creatures adapted to survive in China’s most extreme environments. In the remote mountain realm, predators and scavengers go to great lengths for a meal. High in the jungle canopy, an Asian hornbill carries its family’s future in the tip of its beak. Golden snub-nosed monkeys fight for their right to a family in the mountain forests.

programme.title: The Hidden Kingdoms Of China: Compilation T1 - Ep. 3
programme.desc: Across China’s forest, jungle and high-mountain realms live the wonderfully bizarre and the breathtakingly beautiful. Survival in these hidden kingdoms often requires a unique adaptation. A young giant panda gets a lesson in tree climbing, cool caterpillars show off their colors, and the world’s only venomous primate, the slow loris, enjoys a stealthy snack. These incredible stories offer a rare glimpse into a remarkable world.

programme.title: Japan's Wild Side T1 - Ep. 1
programme.desc: August is a time for preparation in Japan. While apex predators like the Ussuri brown bears hunt for fish, the island nation’s foxes and raccoon dogs scrabble for scraps. Meanwhile, salmon and salamander alike fill Japan’s waterways with their spawn before time runs out. But as swathes of pack ice reach Japan’s shores, they bring the cold threat of icy winter alongside fascinating and unusual creatures like the spectral clione.

programme.title: Japan's Wild Side T1 - Ep. 2
programme.desc: Spring thaw heralds a time for new life and new opportunities after the icy winter. While Japan’s macaques head back to the beaches, a host of creatures — including wild boar, Japanese pheasants, humpback whales and even Amami Ishikawa frogs — are getting started on procreating and rearing their young.

programme.title: The Incredible Dr. Pol T14 - Ep. 21
programme.desc: It's the 2018 Isabella County Fair, and Dr. Pol has his hands full keeping the 4H animals healthy for competition. We follow three young competitors through the ups and downs as they prepare their animals for fair.

programme.title: The Incredible Dr. Pol T14 - Ep. 23
programme.desc: Summer is in full swing in central Michigan, and Pol Veterinary Services is abuzz with ducks, pups, and all sorts of udder emergencies! On top of it all, Diane is out for back surgery, so the PVS team is pulling double duty to make sure nothing slips through the cracks.

programme.title: Indonesia's Volcanic Islands T1 - Ep. 1
programme.desc: Born from fire millions of years ago, Sulawesi is shaped by volcanoes. Over time, its fertile soil yields an incomparable tropical forest with all its unique inhabitants. Some are babirusas, pigs with extra-long teeth, that feast around mineral-rich hot springs, while megapodes rely on geothermal heat to incubate their eggs. In the absence of large predators like leopards, giant pythons and monitor lizards dominate the forests.

programme.title: India's Wild Leopards - Ep. 1
programme.desc: India is home to masters of stealth that prowl the deepest jungles and the highest mountains. Journey to Ladakh within the Himalayas in search of snow leopards – the ghost of the mountains – and venture into the realm of the smallest of big cats – the clouded leopard – within the jungles of Northeast India. Wildlife cameraman Sandesh Kadur is on a mission to uncover their secretive lives.

programme.title: The Hidden Kingdoms Of China: Compilation T1 - Ep. 1

A baby golden snub-nosed monkey climbs her first branch, and a newborn giant panda cub takes his first steps towards independence. From Tibetan foxes to snow leopards, these youngsters learn to navigate their world, face predators and endure the elements.

programme.title: Into The Carpathian Wild T1 - Ep. 2
programme.desc: Summer grants abundance, but in the race to make the most of a brief window of warmth, it also brings competition, aggression and danger. High up on the mountain meadows, Alpine marmots fight for the best hideouts in which to raise young, but can they escape hungry bears? The Carpathian bear cubs are growing fast but are at risk of being attacked by competitive adult males. Can their mothers’ clever strategies protect them?

programme.title: Into The Carpathian Wild T1 - Ep. 3
programme.desc: Autumn transforms the mountainsides of the Carpathians into sweeping carpets of bronze, amber and gold. The forests echo with the powerful roars of red deer stags, signaling the fight for the right to herd females. The battle is gladiatorial, and the weakened losers are picked off by wolf packs prowling for an easy meal across the forests.

programme.title: Into The Carpathian Wild T1 - Ep. 4
programme.desc: Winter favors animals with clever adaptations to survive. Even though the Carpathian Mountains are in the grip of snow and ice, they are still teeming with life. Chamois, a creature descended from the Ice Age, have special hooves to run across steep slopes without slipping, which are perfect for chasing females vertically downhill at the insanely high speeds of 50 kilometers per hour.

programme.title: Dust - Ep. 1
programme.desc: In Botswana, where the Okavango Delta fades into the Kalahari, water and desert clash in a yearly cycle of abundance and loss. Along Africa’s longest zebra migration, herds, predators and desert survivors depend on the fleeting lifeline of the Boteti River.

programme.title: Ultimate Animals Compilations T1 - Ep. 1
programme.desc: The elephant is strong enough to push a two-ton truck, the orangutan has the strength of seven men, and they are both super smart.

programme.title: Secrets Of The Bullshark - Ep. 1
programme.desc: We know Bull Sharks swim upriver and we know they hunt in the sea. But we've never been able to see it all like this. We see them attack and consume other sharks. We watch their shady hunts in the deep. We follow them up freshwater rivers to pupping grounds. We see them hunt shoals of fish from drones above and we watch as they clash with hippos and crocs.

programme.title: The Incredible Pol Farm T1 - Ep. 2
programme.desc: After getting the tractor stuck in mud, Charles and Ben need a quick solution to plant hayseed in their field to provide food for their incoming animals. The Pol family must quickly figure out why their field is so wet even though it hasnt rained in days. Meanwhile, Dr. Pol helps Charles and Beth set up their first beehive colonies on the new farm.

programme.title: Ultimate Animals Compilations T1 - Ep. 2
programme.desc: Pigs can detect smells buried two stories underground and a dog's nose can take you to court.

programme.title: An Elephant's World - Ep. 1
programme.desc: Confronted by fire, famine, predators, and poachers, three elephant families overcome adversity in ways that feel almost human in nature. This documentary will follow the journeys of elephant herds in Kenya, India, and Mali as they migrate towards food and safety, using knowledge shared over generations.

programme.title: Ocean's Weirdest T1 - Ep. 2
programme.desc: In the world’s wettest arena, the Predation Games are underway. It’s play or get played, and the only prize is survival.

programme.title: Secrets Of The Elephants T1 - Ep. 1
programme.desc: This episode reveals the secrets of Namibia’s last remaining desert elephants. When droughts, sandstorms and even floods threaten them, their shared knowledge passed down from generation to generation keeps them alive. This is the toughest place on earth to be an elephant, and their story is one of triumph in a land of extremes.

programme.title: Deep Sea Dwellers - Ep. 1
programme.desc: Movie special-effect gurus are forever trying to invent more compelling creatures from other planets, hoping to terrorize our imaginations. To do this, they often draw from the natural world, and few creatures fit the bill more than the cephalopods: shapeshifters, with three hearts, blue blood and holes in their brains.

programme.title: Secrets Of The Elephants T1 - Ep. 2
programme.desc: Big families and strong relationships are the basis of success for Savanna elephants. As we uncover their secrets we start to understand their remarkable language. It’s not just noise, they communicate like us. Good leadership and close friendships help them through the hard times, as they scale cliffs, find their place in the hierarchy and mourn their dead.

programme.title: Secrets Of The Elephants T1 - Ep. 3
programme.desc: As humans encroach ever further into their environment Asian elephants are learning to adjust to the challenges facing them. They know how to use tools to break down electric fences, strike deals with farmers and have developed a co-operative arrangement on tea plantations where they do the weeding without damaging the crops.

programme.title: Secrets Of The Elephants T1 - Ep. 4
programme.desc: The Congo rainforest is home to one of the world's most elusive species, the African Forest elephant. Everything about them; their bodies, their behaviours, their families, is adapted to life in the rainforest. But surviving here means more than just adapting. These elephants have shaped the forest around them to their needs, and in doing so have created a habitat unlike any other on Earth.

programme.desc: This time on The Incredible Dr. Pol, it's Dr. Pol's turn to be a patient! Decades of rough riding as a legendary country vet have left Doc with severe arthritis in his right ankle.

programme.title: Seen On Safari T1 - Ep. 1
programme.desc: 50 baboons fight a hungry leopard, and an elephant family pulls together to save the smallest in the herd. As the dry season peaks, heading out on safari means checking any remaining waterholes. A leopard hunts bizarre fish in the mud while baboons raid nests on the riverbank. Each event is unpacked and explained, offering a highly charged, emotional and informative ride.

programme.title: Seen On Safari T1 - Ep. 2
programme.desc: Safari action is unpredictable, unexpected and utterly raw. A lion captures birds midair, a baboon steals a leopard cub, a hyena plays tug-of-war with a crocodile, and a terrapin chases a lion away from his waterhole. Heroes and underdogs swap roles as nature’s heartbreak can turn breathtaking in an instant. On safari, you’ll witness nature’s most astonishing characters.

programme.title: Super Reefs - Ep. 1
programme.desc: In 2009, National Geographic Pristine Seas explored the southern Line Islands and found pristine coral reefs, thriving ecosystems teeming with sharks and huge schools of fish. But in 2015-16, an unprecedented ocean warming event killed half of the corals. The Pristine Seas team returned in 2021, hoping to see some signs of recovery. What they found instead was the most spectacular recovery of coral reefs ever witnessed.

programme.title: Ultimate Animals Compilations T1 - Ep. 3
programme.desc: The mantis shrimp has a punch as strong as a bullet and the lion's roar can be heard by other lions 30 miles away.

programme.title: Something Bit Me! T1 - Ep. 5
programme.desc: An expert river guide in Zimbabwe meets more than his match in treacherous waters. Despite repeated maulings that leave him with 38 major bite wounds, he survives to tell his tale. In the Pacific Northwest, a civil servant on a getaway weekend suffers a very uncivilized fate. Ambushed by a hungry animal, he goes toe to toe with his attacker to save himself and his dogs.

programme.title: Ultimate Animals Compilations T1 - Ep. 4
programme.desc: Crows are as smart as dolphins and can talk like parrots. Wolves can hunt for three days straight in a territory the size of Delaware.

programme.title: Wild Life: Resurrection Island - Ep. 1
programme.desc: National Geographic wildlife filmmaker Bertie Gregory goes on an adventure to the iconic South Georgia Island. This island has one of the highest concentration of wildlife on the planet.

programme.title: Africa's Deadliest T3 - Ep. 2
programme.desc: Africa's Deadliest Invaders is a thrilling reveal of the continent's most lethal and fear-inspiring infiltrators. These specialized agents, armed to the teeth, have cunning strategies they deploy to dominate their every environment from the forests of Gabon to the Ethiopian highlands and even the frigid Atlantic Ocean.

programme.title: Panda School T1 - Ep. 1
programme.desc: The junior cubs at Panda School are learning essential life skills, and first on the curriculum is chewing bamboo. It’s tougher than it looks. Even holding it right is a challenge for most of the cubs. Shy Qing Yang catches on quickest, leaving her twin brother, Can Yang, at the bottom of this class. But he’s got other strengths and is soon outsmarting the others with his climbing abilities.

Lying in wait across the continent, from the lush Serengeti to the desert of Namibia, ambush predators are poised for action.

programme.title: Africa's Deadliest T7 - Ep. 1
programme.desc: The vast wetlands of Africa serve as both a refuge and lifeline to the many animals surviving in these spectacular regions. But life and death go hand in hand and these swamps hide dark and deadly secrets. Every sip of water comes with a risk. This episode showcases the deadly ways Africa’s predators use their environment to execute the perfect kill.

programme.title: Panda School T1 - Ep. 2
programme.desc: Lessons at Panda School are getting tougher. The junior cubs are grappling with hard-to-eat bamboo leaves and attempting to climb trees in the rain. Playtime teaches them to channel their innate clumsiness to build a more resilient bear. The cubs begin to crack the panda code, each showing their true colors and demonstrating what their futures might hold.

programme.title: Panda School T1 - Ep. 3
programme.desc: A new class starts at Panda School. Little cubs have spent their whole lives in the maternity unit but will venture outside for the first time into a world full of new sights, new sounds and new Panda Skills to learn. Mini Ling Lang, the oldest of the summer cubs, discovers her mum is an expert climber and tries to take after her. Su Jin Junior is headstrong, and his mom keeps him in line with a no-nonsense teaching style.

programme.title: Saving Giraffes: The Long Journey Home - Ep. 1
programme.desc: A massive flood maroons eight rare-species giraffes on an island. If they’re not rescued, they’ll die. The only solution is far-fetched: build a modern-day ark, convince the giraffes to go aboard, and sail them to the mainland before they starve. The clock is ticking. Can a team of Kenyan vets, tribal leaders, and conservationists from around the world pull it off?

programme.title: Wild Life: Resurrection Island - Ep. 1
programme.desc: National Geographic wildlife filmmaker Bertie Gregory goes on an adventure to the iconic South Georgia Island. This island has one of the highest concentration of wildlife on the planet.

programme.title: The Incredible Dr. Pol T15 - Ep. 1
programme.desc: He's baaaaack! This time on The Incredible Dr. Pol, Doc glides into the clinic with a grin on his face, sporting a newly-replaced ankle and a fresh set of wheels. No toe-touching the ground for six weeks means Dr. Pol is bound to a knee scooter while he keeps things on track at PVS. Hilarity ensues as Doc whizzes around the clinic, recruits Charles as his physician's assistant, and even perfects the art of coffee talk!

programme.title: The Incredible Dr. Pol T15 - Ep. 2
programme.desc: This week, on The Incredible Dr. Pol, 'tis the season for mysterious cases, wild chases, and a little Christmas magic. Doc is still recovering from ankle surgery and rolls into his first case on his scooter only to find two chickens suffering from bare bums! Then, Dr. Emily and Dr. Nicole team up for a farm call to see a cow with a retained placenta - or so they think!

We follow these stealthy predators as they make use of their environments and special skill sets to avoid detection until the very last second. Lying in wait across the continent, from the lush Serengeti to the desert of Namibia, ambush predators are poised for action.

programme.title: Something Bit Me! T1 - Ep. 3

A trip that started as a birthday celebration ends with the greatest gift – survival.

programme.title: Wild Argentina: Extreme Earth T1 - Ep. 3
programme.desc: Water shapes northern Argentina, creating paradises for unique wildlife. Whether it's sooty swifts swooping through waterfall floodwaters, frogs glowing in the dark, cute coati families in the undergrowth, or mighty anacondas on the prowl. Argentina's wetlands hold many wonders.

programme.title: Africa Earth's Wild Home T1 - Ep. 2
programme.desc: The vast plains of Africa are home to the greatest gatherings of wildlife on the planet. Spanning half of Africa, they undergo constant transformation — from violent geological forces that rip the land apart to extreme seasons that change from flood to drought in weeks. To make a home on Africa’s plains, animals must learn to turn the ever-changing conditions to their advantage.

programme.title: Africa Earth's Wild Home T1 - Ep. 5
programme.desc: Jungles cover 900 million acres of Africa. The greatest of all is the Congo, Africa’s green heart. A twisted labyrinth of billions of trees, secret caves and the world’s deepest river, all hiding creatures found nowhere else on Earth. For those able to navigate its many dangers and find hidden opportunities, there is no place like home.

programme.title: Africa Earth's Wild Home T1 - Ep. 4
programme.desc: Africa is a brutal land of extremes. It is the hottest continent on Earth, but in places, temperatures can plummet to 20 below zero. With the fastest-growing population on the planet, the continent is being transformed like never before. Only the most extraordinary animals can survive these extremes by turning danger into opportunity.

programme.title: The Incredible Dr. Pol T15 - Ep. 1
programme.desc: He's baaaaack! This time on The Incredible Dr. Pol, Doc glides into the clinic with a grin on his face, sporting a newly-replaced ankle and a fresh set of wheels. No toe-touching the ground for six weeks means Dr. Pol is bound to a knee scooter while he keeps things on track at PVS. Hilarity ensues as Doc whizzes around the clinic, recruits Charles as his physician's assistant, and even perfects the art of coffee talk!

programme.title: The Incredible Dr. Pol T15 - Ep. 26
programme.desc: This week, on The Incredible Dr. Pol, the vets of PVS pull out their best tricks to treat splits, twists, rolls, and flips - and one of the biggest rabbit Doc's ever laid hands on! From first-time mama dramas to a goat as sweet as honey and a trusty police horse suffering from choke, it's all a balancing act that keeps the vets on their toes!

programme.title: The Incredible Dr. Pol T14 - Ep. 22
programme.desc: This time on The Incredible Dr. Pol, there's a new face entering the fray at PVS: Dr. Nicole Arcy! From squealing sows and delinquent donkeys to magical macaws and equine eye issues, the Docs take it all in stride to get the job done.

programme.title: Africa Earth's Wild Home T1 - Ep. 4
programme.desc: Africa is a brutal land of extremes. It is the hottest continent on Earth, but in places, temperatures can plummet to 20 below zero. With the fastest-growing population on the planet, the continent is being transformed like never before. Only the most extraordinary animals can survive these extremes by turning danger into opportunity.

programme.title: Malika: The Lion Queen T1 - Ep. 1
programme.desc: Narrated by Hollywood A-Lister actress Angela Bassett and produced by the Emmy-Award-winning producers of Planet Earth II, Blue Planet, and Hostile Planet, we journey with Malika as she deals with the hardships of moving from childhood to adulthood. The lioness must learn to hunt and help protect the pride from deadly intruders.

programme.title: Malika: The Lion Queen T1 - Ep. 2
programme.desc: Narrated by Hollywood A-Lister actress Angela Bassett and produced by the Emmy-Award-winning producers of Planet Earth II, Blue Planet, and Hostile Planet, the story of Malika is one of hardship, loneliness, and determination. She must battle her uncles to establish a territory of her own where she can start a family.

programme.title: Cat Attack-Tics - Ep. 1
programme.desc: Explore the many ways wild cats go in for the kill. Cats rarely seen in action, such as the marbled cat, the fishing cat and the sand cat, will all be featured in Cat Attack-tics. Classic Nat Geo footage is mixed with high-tech graphics, freeze frames and photo finishes to magnify the killer weaponry.

programme.title: Big Cat Planet - Ep. 1
programme.desc: Big cats may seem like the ultimate wildlife cliche, but they’re locked in a global battle for survival. Powerful and dangerous, they now clash with humans more than ever. This sweeping safari reveals their resilience and adaptability. Cheetahs hunt from cars, jaguars stalk prey underwater and around boats, and India’s lions prowl city streets.

programme.title: Malika: The Lion Queen T1 - Ep. 2
programme.desc: Narrated by Hollywood A-Lister actress Angela Bassett and produced by the Emmy-Award-winning producers of Planet Earth II, Blue Planet, and Hostile Planet, the story of Malika is one of hardship, loneliness, and determination. She must battle her uncles to establish a territory of her own where she can start a family.

programme.title: Baby Animals Down Under T1 - Ep. 4
programme.desc: Australia's rivers, wetlands, lakes and floodplains provide the perfect nursery for an extraordinary collection of young wildlife. Meet a diverse group of animal youngsters as they take their first steps, swim and dive into the world.

programme.title: Cat Attack-Tics - Ep. 1
programme.desc: Explore the many ways wild cats go in for the kill. Cats rarely seen in action, such as the marbled cat, the fishing cat and the sand cat, will all be featured in Cat Attack-tics. Classic Nat Geo footage is mixed with high-tech graphics, freeze frames and photo finishes to magnify the killer weaponry.

programme.title: Africa's Deadly Kingdom T1 - Ep. 5
programme.desc: The Kalahari. In this place of immense beauty, wonder and contrast all that live here are gifted with unique adaptations in order to survive.

programme.title: Trials Of The Wild T1 - Ep. 3
programme.desc: In Africa's vast Serengeti Plain, one million wildebeest are taking a rare pause for the mothers to have their young in a massive birthing event.

programme.title: Wild, Smart and Deadly T1 - Ep. 1
programme.desc: The battle between predator and prey is not always about power and strength. Knowing what lurks in the dark can mean the difference between life and death. Extraordinary powers that penetrate darkness give some creatures the edge, and the chance to live another day.

programme.title: The Incredible Pol Farm T1 - Ep. 12
programme.desc: It’s winter on the farm, and the Pol’s are adding to their flock! The family is bringing in four merino ewes that were recently bred, which means with any luck the farm could be expecting its first lambs come springtime. And as winter fades into spring, the Pol’s prepare for the new arrivals by building a lambing pen. Meanwhile, Beth checks if her bees survived the winter.

programme.title: Trials Of The Wild T1 - Ep. 10
programme.desc: When you've got it all, why would you give it all up? We expect animals to take the path of least resistance -- choosing the easiest and surest ways to get food, safety and comfort. But animals aren't always so predictable.

programme.title: Wild, Smart and Deadly T1 - Ep. 5
programme.desc: Animals wage a covert war for survival, deploying their hidden weapons with deadly precision. These adaptations, forged by eons of evolution, give animals the edge they need to outwit predators, rivals, and the elements. From the bombardier beetle's boiling spray to the mantis shrimp's explosive club and the draco lizard’s hidden wings, meet nature's awesome secret weapons.

programme.title: Lion T1 - Ep. 1
programme.desc: Born to Summer, queen of a powerful pride, timid lion cub Kio enters a world where every lesson comes at a potential price. One day he may rule a kingdom of his own, but first he must learn to survive. When a buffalo hunt ends in tragedy, Kio gets his first glimpse at how unpredictable life on the savannah can be.

programme.title: Lion T1 - Ep. 2
programme.desc: Against all odds, Kio survives a buffalo attack, but his troubles are far from over. At 12 weeks old, he is the youngest and most vulnerable member of the pride. To have any hope of one day becoming king, he must earn the respect of his older brothers and find his place among them. Just as he is finally able to gain their acceptance, the dry season sets in, and food becomes scarce.

programme.title: Lion T1 - Ep. 3
programme.desc: After a desperate search, Kio and Summer reunite with the brothers — but life on the fringes of the pride’s territory is unforgiving. As Summer struggles to hunt for her inexperienced sons and prepare them for independence, the demands of survival begin to take their toll. When an easy meal proves too tempting to resist. The consequences change Kio’s life forever, forcing him into independence far sooner than expected.

programme.title: Wild, Smart and Deadly T1 - Ep. 1

programme.title: Wild, Smart and Deadly T1 - Ep. 2
programme.desc: To win the game of life, it can take more than brute force. Animals with a super-powered sixth sense can get the edge on fast-moving prey, beat the elements, and find food in unlikely places.

programme.title: Wild, Smart and Deadly T1 - Ep. 3
programme.desc: Animals survive by using camouflage, mimicry, and stealth tactics. From tigers who hunt in plain sight using their orange fur as camouflage, and a spider who mimics an ant to sneak into a colony, to a bird that uses false alarm calls to trick meerkats into giving up their prey, nature deploys remarkable deception to survive.

programme.title: Wild, Smart and Deadly T1 - Ep. 4
programme.desc: In the wild, animals face life or death battles every day, from escaping deadly predators to fighting off fierce rivals. Sometimes brute force isn’t enough to prevail. Survival can depend on death-defying acrobatics, secret senses and hidden weapons - the extraordinary superpowers that help animals survive.

programme.title: The Incredible Dr. Pol T15 - Ep. 5
programme.desc: This week central Michigan is blasted with a blizzard! From canine crises and false alarms to a missing kitty, the docs bundle up and buckle down.

programme.title: The Incredible Dr. Pol T15 - Ep. 4
programme.desc: The Docs are feline fine as they handle every case, call, and client! A bona fide bevy of bovine await Drs. Pol and Nicole as they roll out to Clay Knob for herd health checks. At the clinic, Dr. Brenda works on a ruffed-up Anatolian Shepherd named Darcy while Dr. Emily treats Copper the labradoodle puppy to his first lick of peanut butter: concealing a de-wormer pill.

programme.title: Critter Fixers: Country Vets: Compilations T5 - Ep. 4
programme.desc: Birds of a feather get the help they need from the Critter Fixers. The docs help a goose with laser therapy after a golf cart accident, conduct checkups on a pride of peacocks, and coax a chicken to lay a giant egg. The team performs bone pin surgery on Chewy the goose to try to save his life, and three sisters bring their beloved rooster in for rehab after an attack.

programme.title: Critter Fixers: Country Vets: Compilations T5 - Ep. 3
programme.desc: The Critter Fixer team cares for unusual pets that need extraordinary care. Geri the giant tortoise leaves the clinic shell-shocked. A moray eel gets a much-needed nose job, while a giant goldfish is up to its gills in tumors. Dany the capybara needs lifesaving surgery, Dio the chinchilla chins up for abscess treatment, and a house pig named Bella bites back during a checkup.

programme.title: Africa's Big Five - Ep. 1
programme.desc: Africa's most iconic animals were coined THE BIG FIVE by trophy hunters. See these amazing creatures battle the elements and each other to survive.

programme.title: Seen On Safari T1 - Ep. 3
programme.desc: Lions assert their dominance with ruthless precision, overpowering a hyena with ease. But not every predator submits. Wild dogs return to challenge the balance of power, and when a leopard mother stands her ground against a lion to defend her cubs, survival becomes fierce, raw and unforgiving in the fight to rule the wild.

programme.title: Trials Of The Wild T1 - Ep. 4
programme.desc: The Christmas Island red crab is a land bound crab that still has strong ties to the ocean, the only place where they can give birth to their young.

programme.title: Japan's Wild Side T1 - Ep. 2
programme.desc: Spring thaw heralds a time for new life and new opportunities after the icy winter. While Japan’s macaques head back to the beaches, a host of creatures — including wild boar, Japanese pheasants, humpback whales and even Amami Ishikawa frogs — are getting started on procreating and rearing their young.

programme.title: Trials Of The Wild T1 - Ep. 5
programme.desc: Ain't love grand? Well, to many animals in the wild, attracting a mate and getting the chance to breed is more like a blood sport. The mating urge drives animals to make long journeys, to let down their guard in the presence of predators, and even to fight each other to the death.

programme.title: Asia's Wild Secrets: Compilation T1 - Ep. 1
programme.desc: Across Asia, young animals are born into a battle for survival and each day brings a new set of dangers. Macaques embark on treacherous journeys to find food. An adolescent leopard struggles while learning to hunt. Though they will grow to be apex predators, Komodo dragon hatchlings flee their cannibalistic elders. The risks are great and the reward even greater: the continuation of their species.

programme.title: The Hidden Kingdoms Of China: Compilation T1 - Ep. 2
programme.desc: In this special episode, follow the rare and deadly creatures adapted to survive in China’s most extreme environments. In the remote mountain realm, predators and scavengers go to great lengths for a meal. High in the jungle canopy, an Asian hornbill carries its family’s future in the tip of its beak. Golden snub-nosed monkeys fight for their right to a family in the mountain forests.

programme.title: Wild Taiwan: Jungle Island - Ep. 1
programme.desc: Taiwan is an island like no other. Sitting abreast the Tropic of Cancer, this small slice of Asia hosts tropical beaches, misty forests and icecapped mountains.

programme.title: Asia's Wild Secrets: Compilation T1 - Ep. 1
programme.desc: Across Asia, young animals are born into a battle for survival and each day brings a new set of dangers. Macaques embark on treacherous journeys to find food. programme.title: The Hidden Kingdoms Of China: Compilation T1 - Ep. 3
programme.desc: Across China’s forest, jungle and high-mountain realms live the wonderfully bizarre and the breathtakingly beautiful. Survival in these hidden kingdoms often requires a unique adaptation. A young giant panda gets a lesson in tree climbing, cool caterpillars show off their colors, and the world’s only venomous primate, the slow loris, enjoys a stealthy snack. These incredible stories offer a rare glimpse into a remarkable world.

programme.title: Japan's Wild Side T1 - Ep. 1
programme.desc: August is a time for preparation in Japan. While apex predators like the Ussuri brown bears hunt for fish, the island nation’s foxes and raccoon dogs scrabble for scraps. Meanwhile, salmon and salamander alike fill Japan’s waterways with their spawn before time runs out. But as swathes of pack ice reach Japan’s shores, they bring the cold threat of icy winter alongside fascinating and unusual creatures like the spectral clione.

programme.title: Wild Taiwan: Jungle Island - Ep. 1
programme.desc: Taiwan is an island like no other. Sitting abreast the Tropic of Cancer, this small slice of Asia hosts tropical beaches, misty forests and icecapped mountains.

programme.title: Untamed Philippines T1 - Ep. 2
programme.desc: Moving from turtles of the Palawan coast to the unique National Marine Park at Tubbataha, to meet giants, whale sharks and manta rays. We also see how people can mediate between people and wildlife as we join a snake hunting team catching and translocating a deadly Samar cobra.

programme.title: Untamed Philippines T1 - Ep. 1
programme.desc: We start on the tiny island of Batan, meeting a unique viper and a ubiquitous but also giant, land crab. Luzon is the main island of the Philippines. We drop in to Mindoro to see the most endangered large mammal in the Philippines, the tamaraw.

programme.title: Asia's Killer Hornets - Ep. 1
programme.desc: Every Asian giant hornet colony starts with a single queen. Leaving one hive to start another, she’ll quickly transform an empty lair into a bustling army of ruthless, efficient killing machines. These hornets will sacrifice everything to help raise legions of grubs and protect the hive at all costs.

programme.title: Asia's Wild Secrets: Compilation T1 - Ep. 1
programme.desc: Across Asia, young animals are born into a battle for survival and each day brings a new set of dangers. Macaques embark on treacherous journeys to find food. An adolescent leopard struggles while learning to hunt. Though they will grow to be apex predators, Komodo dragon hatchlings flee their cannibalistic elders. The risks are great and the reward even greater: the continuation of their species.

programme.title: The Incredible Dr. Pol T15 - Ep. 6
programme.desc: The struggle is real with the patients of PVS this week, who have managed to find their way into serious trouble. A Boer goat gets tangled up in a wire fence causing a life-threatening leg injury, while a Weimaraner finds herself between a sock and a hard place. But not all injuries are self-inflicted? an unlucky buck meets the business end of a dart and a mite party is raging in a giant rabbit's ears. Buckle your seatbelts, folks?

programme.title: The Incredible Dr. Pol T15 - Ep. 7
programme.desc: Dr. Pol sees thousands of patients every year and, yet, only one pint-sized pony's managed to capture his unbridled love--Charlie the Mini-Horse! On this very special episode, we deep dive into the unique bond that Doc and this amazing therapy horse have formed over the years.

programme.title: Indonesia's Volcanic Islands T1 - Ep. 2
programme.desc: Komodo is a harsh landscape shaped by heat and drought, and it is home to the Komodo dragon, the world's largest lizard. This skilled predator can grow up to 3 meters long and even crosses stretches of sea between islands. Beneath the waves, some of the ocean's largest creatures gather, including manta rays and ocean sunfish, which rise from the depths to shed parasites.

programme.title: Wild India T1 - Ep. 1
programme.desc: In India’s deserts, predators and prey battle each other and the harshest of landscapes for food, water, and breeding rights. Leopards, lions, wolves, foxes and hyenas have adapted to face the brutal challenges of surviving here. Yet every year, extreme drought and searing heat test them to their limits.

programme.title: Into The Carpathian Wild T1 - Ep. 4
programme.desc: Winter favors animals with clever adaptations to survive. Even though the Carpathian Mountains are in the grip of snow and ice, they are still teeming with life. Chamois, a creature descended from the Ice Age, have special hooves to run across steep slopes without slipping, which are perfect for chasing females vertically downhill at the insanely high speeds of 50 kilometers per hour.

programme.title: Trials Of The Wild T1 - Ep. 6
programme.desc: A deadly predator is stalking the forests of Costa Rica. No, it's not a jaguar, it's a super organism made up of half a million tiny individuals -- an army ant colony.

programme.title: An Elephant's World - Ep. 1
programme.desc: Confronted by fire, famine, predators, and poachers, three elephant families overcome adversity in ways that feel almost human in nature. This documentary will follow the journeys of elephant herds in Kenya, India, and Mali as they migrate towards food and safety, using knowledge shared over generations.

programme.title: Ultimate Animals Compilations T1 - Ep. 2
programme.desc: Pigs can detect smells buried two stories underground and a dog's nose can take you to court.

programme.title: Trials Of The Wild T1 - Ep. 7
programme.desc: On the edge of the Sahara Desert in Mali, a society struggles to thrive. This isn't a society of humans but of rare desert elephants. More than just a herd of animals, they are a tribe of extended families and comrades with their own unique culture.

programme.title: Secrets Of The Penguins T1 - Ep. 3
programme.desc: Millions of years ago, a group of penguins left the ice in search of more. Riding powerful currents, the tiny adventurers arrived in strange new lands, reshaping traditions for deserts, tropics … and even among humans. They were tested to the extreme, becoming perhaps the smartest of them all. National Geographic Explorer Bertie Gregory discovers penguin problem solving, ‘talking’, and their enduring search for new worlds.

programme.title: Secrets Of The Elephants T1 - Ep. 2
programme.desc: Big families and strong relationships are the basis of success for Savanna elephants. As we uncover their secrets we start to understand their remarkable language. It’s not just noise, they communicate like us. Good leadership and close friendships help them through the hard times, as they scale cliffs, find their place in the hierarchy and mourn their dead.

programme.title: Secrets Of The Bees T1 - Ep. 1
programme.desc: National Geographic Explorer Bertie Gregory explores the extraordinary lives of bees — among the planet’s most important animals. Over three years, special cameras opened a rare window into a single hive, revealing their hidden world. But with more than 20,000 bee species pollinating one-third of the world’s food, this series uncovers their astonishing architecture and intelligence, unlocking their secrets.

programme.title: Secrets Of The Penguins T1 - Ep. 3
programme.desc: Millions of years ago, a group of penguins left the ice in search of more. programme.title: Secrets Of The Elephants T1 - Ep. 3
programme.desc: As humans encroach ever further into their environment Asian elephants are learning to adjust to the challenges facing them. They know how to use tools to break down electric fences, strike deals with farmers and have developed a co-operative arrangement on tea plantations where they do the weeding without damaging the crops.

programme.title: Secrets Of The Elephants T1 - Ep. 4
programme.desc: The Congo rainforest is home to one of the world's most elusive species, the African Forest elephant. Everything about them; their bodies, their behaviours, their families, is adapted to life in the rainforest. But surviving here means more than just adapting. These elephants have shaped the forest around them to their needs, and in doing so have created a habitat unlike any other on Earth.

programme.title: Secrets Of The Bees T1 - Ep. 1

programme.title: Secrets Of The Bees T1 - Ep. 2
programme.desc: National Geographic Explorer Bertie Gregory returns to the honeybee sisterhood as they race to rebuild before winter. Across the planet, other bees face challenges of their own — from Dawson’s bees battling for mates to honeybees facing the global spread of varroa mites. With Explorer Dr. Sammy Ramsey, Bertie explores the mounting pressures on bees and bold solutions to secure their future.

programme.title: Secrets Of The Penguins T1 - Ep. 1
programme.desc: The emperors are the largest and strongest of all penguins, living in the coldest, most extreme place on Earth. National Geographic Explorer Bertie Gregory embeds with an Antarctic colony and encounters social skills never filmed before. As the planet rapidly warms, he discovers bonds forged from birth between family, friends and strangers are the difference between life and death.

programme.title: Secrets Of The Penguins T1 - Ep. 2
programme.desc: It takes a special type of courageous penguin to survive the fierce Southern Ocean, but forty million crowd its isolated, rocky outposts. They are the most successful penguins on Earth. National Geographic Explorer Bertie Gregory follows the rockhoppers, gentoos and macaronis to discover a world of risk-takers, rebels, and unconventional parents.

programme.title: Secrets Of The Penguins T1 - Ep. 3

programme.title: The Incredible Dr. Pol T15 - Ep. 8
programme.desc: Winter is on its way out but not before blasting the Mitten with one last ice storm! This week, central Michigan faces freezing temperatures and white-out conditions, making work even more difficult than usual for the vets at PVS. From frigid farm calls to slippery roads and a string of ice-related injuries, Pol Vet is ready for anything!

programme.title: The Incredible Dr. Pol T15 - Ep. 9
programme.desc: Tensions run high when the vets face some of their most challenging cases, yet! Dr. Emily tackles two stalled labors and the victim of an after-hours dog fight, while Doc Pol rushes from one call to the next, while helping Charles' Great Dane puppy, Atlas, get back on his feet. When animals are in need, there's no such thing as '9 to 5', so the vets of PVS are working around the clock!

programme.title: Birth Of A Pride - Ep. 1
programme.desc: The story follows two males lions who swam across the river from Namibia, and joined up with 2 females in Selinda. This union resulted in 6 cubs who are the core of our story.

programme.title: Lion T1 - Ep. 1
programme.desc: Born to Summer, queen of a powerful pride, timid lion cub Kio enters a world where every lesson comes at a potential price. One day he may rule a kingdom of his own, but first he must learn to survive. When a buffalo hunt ends in tragedy, Kio gets his first glimpse at how unpredictable life on the savannah can be.

programme.title: Ocean's Weirdest T1 - Ep. 3
programme.desc: Life can be a wild ride and nature can be a cruel mistress. When it’s adapt or die weird has the edge. Embrace the strange in Mutant Misadventures.

programme.title: Super Reefs - Ep. 1
programme.desc: In 2009, National Geographic Pristine Seas explored the southern Line Islands and found pristine coral reefs, thriving ecosystems teeming with sharks and huge schools of fish. But in 2015-16, an unprecedented ocean warming event killed half of the corals. The Pristine Seas team returned in 2021, hoping to see some signs of recovery. What they found instead was the most spectacular recovery of coral reefs ever witnessed.

programme.title: Trials Of The Wild T1 - Ep. 8
programme.desc: Who says everything happens on the ground? And who says you need wings to fly? Welcome to the canopy of the Borneo rainforest, where the best action is high in the air, swinging from branches and leaping through the treetops. Animals here do everything without ever touching the ground.

programme.title: Wild Life: Resurrection Island - Ep. 1
programme.desc: National Geographic wildlife filmmaker Bertie Gregory goes on an adventure to the iconic South Georgia Island. This island has one of the highest concentration of wildlife on the planet.

programme.title: Trials Of The Wild T1 - Ep. 9
programme.desc: Life is risky, and no stage of life is riskier than the very beginning. Most animals are born frail, vulnerable, and with a lot of learning to do. But life doesn't go easy on the newcomers.

programme.title: Baby Animals Down Under T1 - Ep. 5
programme.desc: Far beyond Australia's cities and coastlines lies the vast outback, a rugged landscape where young animals must quickly learn how to survive. Meet a remarkable group of babies taking their first steps toward independence, from emu chicks guided by devoted fathers to dingo pups learning the rules of pack life and camel calves crossing the desert alongside their protective mothers.

programme.title: Panda School T1 - Ep. 2
programme.desc: Lessons at Panda School are getting tougher. The junior cubs are grappling with hard-to-eat bamboo leaves and attempting to climb trees in the rain. Playtime teaches them to channel their innate clumsiness to build a more resilient bear. The cubs begin to crack the panda code, each showing their true colors and demonstrating what their futures might hold.

programme.title: Baby Animals Down Under T1 - Ep. 1
programme.desc: Journey into Australia's forests to meet an unforgettable cast of baby animals. Follow koala joeys as they go from tiny pouch-bound newborns to adventurous climbers. Watch flying fox pups grow into skilled young fliers, while kookaburra chicks discover their voices and begin exploring the world beyond the nest.

programme.title: Baby Animals Down Under T1 - Ep. 5

programme.title: Panda School T1 - Ep. 3
programme.desc: A new class starts at Panda School. Little cubs have spent their whole lives in the maternity unit but will venture outside for the first time into a world full of new sights, new sounds and new Panda Skills to learn. Mini Ling Lang, the oldest of the summer cubs, discovers her mum is an expert climber and tries to take after her. Su Jin Junior is headstrong, and his mom keeps him in line with a no-nonsense teaching style.

programme.title: Saving Giraffes: The Long Journey Home - Ep. 1
programme.desc: A massive flood maroons eight rare-species giraffes on an island. If they’re not rescued, they’ll die. The only solution is far-fetched: build a modern-day ark, convince the giraffes to go aboard, and sail them to the mainland before they starve. The clock is ticking. Can a team of Kenyan vets, tribal leaders, and conservationists from around the world pull it off?

programme.title: Baby Animals Down Under T1 - Ep. 1

programme.title: Baby Animals Down Under T1 - Ep. 3
programme.desc: Journey deep into the Australian bush and discover a remarkable world of baby animals growing up beyond the cities and coastline. Meet wombat youngsters learning to explore their underground world and tiny echidna puggles developing the protective spines that will help them survive.

programme.title: Baby Animals Down Under T1 - Ep. 4
programme.desc: Australia's rivers, wetlands, lakes and floodplains provide the perfect nursery for an extraordinary collection of young wildlife. Meet a diverse group of animal youngsters as they take their first steps, swim and dive into the world.

programme.desc: America's favorite vet quartet barely frets as they're faced with questions, quadrupled, on the downbeat of another busy day. It's sure to be a wild ride on this jaw-dropping, head bopping, heart-stopping, episode of The Incredible Dr. Pol.

programme.desc: This week, Doc and Diane fall head-over-paws for a sweet Great Dane puppy looking for her fur-ever home. programme.title: Arq 3 T2 - Ep. 7
programme.desc: Esta semana vamos até Grândola conhecer o Sobreiras Alentejo Country Hotel, um espaço tranquilo onde a arquitetura pousa no terreno sem o invadir. Em Coimbra, descobrimos a Casa Robalo Cordeiro, uma habitação que nasceu das ruínas de uma antiga moradia e na Póvoa do Lanhoso encontramos a Casa MGM, inspirada no meio onde se insere dando primazia a materiais da região, como o xisto.

programme.title: Memórias Do Século XX - Ep. 3
programme.desc: Cottinelli Telmo nasceu em Lisboa em 1897. É um dos nomes mais destacados da primeira geração da arquitetura modernista portuguesa, que emerge no contexto tradicionalista da época, os anos 1925-35, e que acompanha a ascensão de um novo gosto europeu moderno. Exemplo disso na sua obra é a Estação dos Caminhos de Ferro Sul Sueste.

programme.title: O Santo T5 - Ep. 8
programme.desc: Roger Moore é o famoso Simon Templar 'O Santo', carismático, astuto, encantador e muito esquivo. Playboy internacional, 'O Santo' luta contra a injustiça. Roger Moore imortalizou-se na série da década de 60 e a sua fama e reputação nunca mais foi esquecida. Primeira temporada a cores.

programme.title: Regresso A Sizalinda - Ep. 37
programme.desc: No hospital Leonor começa a reagir perante a perplexidade do médico e diz que parece que ela tomou alguma coisa. Henrique fala com Juca e diz-lhe que lhe devem a vida de Leonor, este responde que só fez o que o seu coração mandou. Armando e Juca concordam que o melhor para todos é ele desaparecer por uns tempos. Fernando informa Malaquias que ainda não consegui transferir as contas.

programme.title: Serviço De Urgência T2 - Ep. 20
programme.desc: Série galardoada que segue a vida movimentada no Serviço de Urgência do Hospital Cook County em Chicago, e os desafios pessoas e profissionais do pessoal médico e assistente. Com Anthony Edwards, George Clooney, Sherry Stringfield, Noah Wyle, Julianna Margulies, Eriq La Salle entre outros, nos protagonistas.

programme.title: A Essência T5 - Ep. 13
programme.desc: Programa semanal sobre a vinha e os vinhos portugueses em Portugal e no mundo. O mercado nacional e o mercado de exportação. A excelência de alguns dos nossos vinhos

programme.title: A Grande Aposta - Ep. 104
programme.desc: A história passa-se cerca de 20 anos depois de ter sido feita a Grande Aposta que dá nome a esta novela. Carlos Costa, filho de uma família rica, tinha então 26 anos. Ele e o seu amigo Fernando, de 29, estão a praticar vela na Baía de Cascais, quando se levanta um temporal. Já de volta ao Clube Naval, dão-se conta de um pequeno barco à vela com problemas para regressar, e decidem tentar ajudar.

programme.title: Guarda-factos Micro
programme.desc: Micro programa sobre efemérides que marcaram o país e o mundo, nesse mês, ao longo dos anos. Com apresentação de Mário Carneiro, os factos guardados no imenso arquivo da RTP.

programme.title: Notícias Do Meu País T1 - Ep. 7
programme.desc: Bruno Costa não teve uma infância fácil. Os pais tiveram de emigrar para Newark, nos Estados Unidos da América, e ele teve de ficar ao cuidado dos avós. Quando mais precisou, os pais não estiveram presentes. Sete anos depois, já adolescente, é o reencontro. No entanto, ficou a mágoa de ter de separar-se e deixar para trás os avós. A adaptação à vida norte-americana foi difícil.

programme.title: Bem-vindos A Beirais T4 - Ep. 231
programme.desc: Na agência funerária Joaquim comenta com Moisés que podiam aderir ao telemarketing, para angariar clientes para funerais: Moisés diz que a ideia é estúpida, mas Joaquim diz que o que é preciso é atrair fregueses e acusa Moisés de não ter espírito empreendedor. Diz que resolve o assunto, como sempre. O minimercado continua cheio de gente até à porta. Os clientes usam o cartão Alzirex. Manel entra e fica espantado.

programme.title: Os Andrades - Ep. 9
programme.desc: Acompanhe, semanalmente, as aventuras e desventuras caricatas de uma família do norte que vive histórias atribuladas mas bem dispostas, onde a amizade e a confusão são uma constante.

programme.title: Doutora Quinn T2 - Ep. 27
programme.desc: Série que acompanha a história da Dra. Michaela Quinn, (Jane Seymour) uma médica de Boston que se muda para a pequena cidade fronteiriça de Colorado Springs, no século XIX. Enfrentando o preconceito por ser mulher numa profissão dominada por homens, a Dra. Quinn conquista gradualmente o respeito da comunidade, enquanto constrói uma nova vida.

programme.title: Os Nossos Dias T2 - Ep. 34
programme.desc: Tiago encontra Teresa e Sofia a jantar. Tiago mostra-se surpreendido por ver Teresa já fora de casa mas Sofia dá uma ajuda à amiga arranjando uma desculpa. Teresa aproveita para questionar Tiago sobre Guilherme e este acaba por lhe dizer que o amigo e Alice vão oficializar o namoro. Teresa fica furiosa. Em casa, Guilherme comunica aos pais que namora com Alice.

programme.title: Diário De Maria - Ep. 44
programme.desc: 'O Diário de Maria' é a crónica da vida de uma mulher na Lisboa contemporânea, navegando através dos mares da vida, tentando sobreviver às tempestades, tirando partido dos ventos favoráveis, com o objectivo de conseguir chegar ao porto seguro de um futuro esforçado mas feliz. Maria tem vinte e sete anos, é solteira e tem raízes pequeno-burguesas. Os seus problemas são os mesmos de qualquer outra mulher em qualquer parte do mundo.

programme.title: Tal Pai, Tal Filho T1 - Ep. 13
programme.desc: Tal Pai, Tal Filho é um concurso apresentado por José Jorge Duarte, com uma banda ao vivo, onde pais e filhos concorrem entre si. Integrando a feitura de textos, a apresentação de vídeos caseiros e diversas provas de caráter físico e cultural, este concurso pertence a uma linha de programas muito usada pela RTP para aproximar pessoas de gerações diferentes.

programme.title: Passeio Das Estrelas
programme.desc: Celebra-se a carreira de Júlio Isidro através das entrevistas incríveis realizadas pelo próprio ao longo de mais de 50 anos. Uma autêntica ?viagem ao baú?. Trazer para a frente as entrevistas de Júlio Isidro a grandes estrelas de calibre mundial (de Woody Allen a Gilberto Gil, por exemplo).

programme.title: Fenómeno - Ep. 7
programme.desc: Estaremos sós? Esta é, seguramente, uma das maiores questões que o Homem se coloca e, para a qual não temos, ainda, resposta. A vida extraterrestre é, do ponto de vista da probabilidade matemática, algo tão palpável como a nossa própria existência. O termo OVNI é uma sigla que representa as palavras Objecto Voador Não Identificado. Vamos conhecer pessoas que afirmam ter avistado objectos que não souberam identificar.

programme.title: Pessa À Peça
programme.desc: Estes microprogramas mostram o trabalho jornalístico de Fernando Pessa (1902-2002) e assinalam os 20 anos da sua morte, no mesmo ano em que se comemoram os 120 anos do seu nascimento. As expressões como 'E esta hein?!' ou 'Parece impossível!' faziam da ironia e da irreverência algumas das qualidades profissionais que partilhou com os telespectadores entre 1957 e 2002.

programme.title: Gostos E Sabores T1 - Ep. 21
programme.desc: Programa de gastronomia com receitas de cozinha portuguesa e internacional, tendo sempre um convidado que expõe os seus dotes e gostos culinários. O programa será conduzido pelo chefe Hélio Loureiro, o cozinheiro da seleção nacional de futebol. Como convidados, entre outros, estarão jogadores e ex-jogadores de futebol, que revelarão os seus pratos preferidos e a sua habilidade culinária.

programme.title: A Grandiosa Enciclopédia Do Ludopédio T3 - Ep. 26

programme.title: Culinária - Ep. 117

Assim, o Chefe António Silva, Filipa Vacondeus, Manuel Luís Goucha entre muitos outros, vão dar as suas melhores receitas para umas saborosas refeições.

programme.title: Ricardina E Marta - Ep. 12
programme.desc: Esta novela passa-se em Portugal, no século XIX, e a sua história divide-se em dois períodos fundamentais. A primeira parte começa com a notícia da morte do Rei D. João VI, que vai intensificar os conflitos entre Liberais e Absolutistas, conflitos estes protagonizados pelos personagens da Novela: Morgado de Espinho personifica o Absolutismo radical, enquanto que Silvestre Moniz da Fonte é a imagem das Ideias Liberais moderadas.

programme.title: A Grande Aposta - Ep. 105
programme.desc: A história passa-se cerca de 20 anos depois de ter sido feita a Grande Aposta que dá nome a esta novela. Carlos Costa, filho de uma família rica, tinha então 26 anos. Ele e o seu amigo Fernando, de 29, estão a praticar vela na Baía de Cascais, quando se levanta um temporal. Já de volta ao Clube Naval, dão-se conta de um pequeno barco à vela com problemas para regressar, e decidem tentar ajudar.

programme.title: Liga Dos Últimos - Ep. 61
programme.desc: A Liga dos Últimos já está em disputa na RTP. Equipas de todo o país mostram o que valem, ou não, num programa que põe a classificação do país de pernas para o ar. Chicotadas Psicológicas, guarda-redes em crise, jogadores desesperados e clubes falidos animam o programa desportivo onde todos os que vão em último são as estrelas.

programme.title: À Velocidade Da Inquietação - Amadeo De Souza-cardoso
programme.desc: Filho de uma família abastada de proprietários rurais, Amadeo foi um entre nove irmãos e desde cedo revelou grandes aptidões artísticas. Estreou-se na caricatura, passou por arquitetura mas foi na pintura que verdadeiramente se realizou. Determinado e muito seguro de si, Amadeo depressa percebeu que era em Paris que queria desenvolver as suas capacidades. Em 1906, com 18 anos, partiu para a ?cidade luz?

programme.title: O Santo T5 - Ep. 4
programme.desc: Roger Moore é o famoso Simon Templar 'O Santo', carismático, astuto, encantador e muito esquivo. Playboy internacional, 'O Santo' luta contra a injustiça. Roger Moore imortalizou-se na série da década de 60 e a sua fama e reputação nunca mais foi esquecida. Primeira temporada a cores.

programme.title: RTP - Retratos De Uma Televisão - Ep. 1
programme.desc: Os antecedentes da criação da RTP e as diferentes visões que Salazar e Marcello Caetano tinham da televisão. A história começa: das emissões experimentais na Feira Popular, em 1956, à visita da Rainha Isabel II a Portugal (início de 1957) e ao começo das emissões regulares a 7 de Março de 1957. O nascimento da RTP feita com meios escassos mas com um entusiasmo transbordante por parte dos seus profissionais.

programme.title: Crónica Do Século T1 - Ep. 3
programme.desc: Os anos de 1917 e 1918 foram dos piores do Século XX em Portugal. Os portugueses morreram aos milhares: em consequência de fomes, de epidemias, de lutas internas e nas frentes de combate da Primeira Guerra Mundial. A miséria fez surgir fenómenos messiânicos, como as aparições de Fátima e de Sidónio Pais, um desconhecido professor de matemática de Coimbra que, em Dezembro de 1917, derruba o governo de Afonso Costa e, surgindo aos...

programme.title: Hora Cinemateca T1 - Ep. 35
programme.desc: Caldas de Aregos é uma estância termal situada junto ao rio Douro e faz parte do concelho de Resende. Consta que foi aqui tratado, nas suas águas sulforosas, D. Afonso Henriques.

programme.title: Hora Cinemateca T1 - Ep. 36
programme.desc: Faria de Almeida transporta-nos para o Portugal Desconhecido de 1969. De gastronomia ao artesanato, das paisagens às feiras, das cidades às praias.

programme.title: Hora Cinemateca T1 - Ep. 37
programme.desc: Obra da Casa do Gaiato, em Paço de Sousa, Penafial, fruto do trabalho do Padre Américo. Uma instituição de caridade que alberga, educa e integra jovens desprovidos de uma estável estrutura familiar. Filme curioso que sobrepõe momentos ficcionados com o pequeno Ernesto e uma parte documental e narrativa.

programme.title: Tributo Em Estúdio T6 - Ep. 33
programme.desc: Maria João Gama à conversa com convidados ligados a grandes nomes do panorama artístico nacional.

programme.title: Herman Zap
programme.desc: Herman Zap é uma rubrica televisiva humorística inserida no programa Parabéns, apresentado por Herman José. É o regresso à sátira televisiva e aos sketches humorísticos, apresentando-se acompanhado por um elenco formado por Maria Rueff, Lídia Franco, Miguel Guilherme, José Pedro Gomes e Vítor de Sousa.

programme.title: Estrada Do Êxito: Carlos Avilez
programme.desc: Ainda nos primórdios da sua carreira, vemos Carlos Avilez em ensaios a conduzir atores e num processo de construção de uma peça de Teatro. Começou como ator, mas foi como encenador que solidificou a sua carreira. Avilez é um dos fundadores, em 1965, do Teatro Experimental de Cascais (TEC) e um dos grandes obreiros de um novo teatro em Portugal.

programme.title: O Estado Das Coisas
programme.desc: Rodado parcialmente em Portugal, 'O Estado das Coisas' é um filme mítico sobre o cinema e a sua produção. Vencedor do Leão de Ouro no Festival de Veneza (1982), conta a história da rodagem de um filme que é interrompido devido à falta de financiamento. Wim Wenders faz aqui um exorcismo à sua própria situação na rodagem do filme 'Hammett', com produção norte-americana, onde se confronta com divergências artísticas.

programme.title: Terra Instável T1 - Ep. 6
programme.desc: Série de ficção baseado no conto homónimo de Eça de Queiroz, sobre 3 irmãos à procura de um tesouro. Com os atores José Meireles, Mário Timóteo, Fernando Candeias, Fernando Soares, Brito Macedo e Cristina Reis.

programme.title: A Grande Aposta - Ep. 105
programme.desc: A história passa-se cerca de 20 anos depois de ter sido feita a Grande Aposta que dá nome a esta novela. Carlos Costa, filho de uma família rica, tinha então 26 anos. Ele e o seu amigo Fernando, de 29, estão a praticar vela na Baía de Cascais, quando se levanta um temporal. programme.title: Notícias Do Meu País T1 - Ep. 8
programme.desc: Norberto é um ribatejano de corpo e alma. Com 48 anos, sabe o que é deixar tudo pela família. Para dar uma vida melhor aos filhos, viu-se obrigado a deixar Portugal e a emigrar para França. Está em Lyon, longe da família, mas satisfeito por poder dar aos filhos o que nunca teve, a possibilidade de estudar. Não encara esta distância como um sacrifício, mas como uma opção necessária de vida.

programme.title: Bem-vindos A Beirais T4 - Ep. 232
programme.desc: Na sociedade, gera-se uma confusão numa conversa em que Olga e Susana levam a crer que Fernando vai dar um irmão a Domingos. Este sai do local a resmungar a dizer que é desta maneira que se geram os boatos na aldeia. No minimercado Inês discute com Gabriel, pois este não a corresponde como ela gostaria. Fernando chega a casa e comenta com Mercês a conversa que se estava a ter na sociedade, mas não chega a dizer o tema da confusão.

programme.title: Os Andrades - Ep. 10
programme.desc: Acompanhe, semanalmente, as aventuras e desventuras caricatas de uma família do norte que vive histórias atribuladas mas bem dispostas, onde a amizade e a confusão são uma constante.

programme.title: A Grandiosa Enciclopédia Do Ludopédio T3 - Ep. 26
programme.desc: Carlos Manuel Albuquerque, Rui Miguel Tovar e João Nuno Coelho fazem um programa alternativo sobre futebol. Um dicionário da tribo da bola, com histórias diferentes dentro e fora das quatro linhas.

programme.title: Os Nossos Dias T2 - Ep. 35
programme.desc: De regresso de um serviço, Santos entrega a Regina uma pasta que um cliente deixou ficar no carro. Regina abre a pasta e esconde-se dentro do guichet longe dos olhares de Maria João, quando percebe que se trata de documentos de uma figura pública da RTP. Valdemar desconfiado do que se passa com Celeste, aproveita a hora em que não tem serviço para ir a casa controlar a mulher.

programme.title: Diário De Maria - Ep. 45
programme.desc: 'O Diário de Maria' é a crónica da vida de uma mulher na Lisboa contemporânea, navegando através dos mares da vida, tentando sobreviver às tempestades, tirando partido dos ventos favoráveis, com o objectivo de conseguir chegar ao porto seguro de um futuro esforçado mas feliz. Maria tem vinte e sete anos, é solteira e tem raízes pequeno-burguesas. Os seus problemas são os mesmos de qualquer outra mulher em qualquer parte do mundo.

programme.title: Passeio Das Estrelas
programme.desc: Celebra-se a carreira de Júlio Isidro através das entrevistas incríveis realizadas pelo próprio ao longo de mais de 50 anos. Uma autêntica ?viagem ao baú?. Trazer para a frente as entrevistas de Júlio Isidro a grandes estrelas de calibre mundial (de Woody Allen a Gilberto Gil, por exemplo).

programme.title: Tal Pai, Tal Filho T1 - Ep. 14
programme.desc: Tal Pai, Tal Filho é um concurso apresentado por José Jorge Duarte, com uma banda ao vivo, onde pais e filhos concorrem entre si. Integrando a feitura de textos, a apresentação de vídeos caseiros e diversas provas de caráter físico e cultural, este concurso pertence a uma linha de programas muito usada pela RTP para aproximar pessoas de gerações diferentes.

programme.title: Passeio Das Estrelas
programme.desc: Celebra-se a carreira de Júlio Isidro através das entrevistas incríveis realizadas pelo próprio ao longo de mais de 50 anos. Uma autêntica ?viagem ao baú?. programme.title: Fenómeno - Ep. 8
programme.desc: SANTA DA LADEIRA Maria da Conceição Mendes Horta foi uma menina diferente das outras. A mãe proibiu-a de falar dos encontros que dizia ter com Nossa Senhora... mas era impossível abafar o fenómeno. A partir de Novembro de 1962, a igreja católica recusou-lhe os sacramentos, afirmando que Maria da Conceição mentia acerca das pretensas aparições. É óbvio que estes acontecimentos nunca poderiam passar despercebidos.

programme.title: Ouvir Quem Vê Num Minuto - Ep. 25
programme.desc: 'Ouvir Quem Vê Num Minuto' é um programa da responsabilidade de Clara Almeida Santos, Provedora do Telespectador da RTP dedicado a dar voz ao público e a reforçar a transparência do serviço público de televisão. Num formato acessível e focado no rigor, 'Ouvir Quem Vê Num Minuto' aproxima o serviço público dos cidadãos, esclarece, questiona e contribui para uma televisão mais transparente, diversa e responsável.

programme.title: Um Dia Com... T3 - Ep. 24
programme.desc: Programa dedicado a Dina Moreira de Oliveira, atriz de teatro e cinema conhecida por Dina Teresa, que aborda momentos importantes da sua vida e percurso artístico.

programme.title: Primeira Pessoa: Sérgio Conceição
programme.desc: É o sétimo dos oito filhos de Maria Alice e José Conceição. Uma história de vida marcada pela perda prematura dos pais e de um irmão. Factos que Sérgio Conceiçao, jogador internacional, actual treinador de futebol, diz que definiram o seu carácter para sempre. Casado e pai de cinco filhos, vive o futebol, e a sua profissão numa entrega sem limites, e lidera os seus jogadores, por entre regras e afectos.

programme.title: Sul T1 - Ep. 4
programme.desc: A investigação conduz Humberto às altas esferas económicas. A situação financeira de Matilha e Mafalda, sua namorada, degrada-se. O marginal tenta ajudar dois amigos, mas tudo se complica.

programme.title: A Aventura
programme.desc: Anna, uma jovem burguesa, desaparece misteriosamente durante uma viagem de iate a uma ilha vulcânica remota do Mediterrâneo. Sandro, o namorado, e, Claudia, a sua melhor amiga, partem em sua busca e acabam por se apaixonar.

programme.title: Tributo Em Estúdio T6 - Ep. 33
programme.desc: Maria João Gama à conversa com convidados ligados a grandes nomes do panorama artístico nacional.

programme.title: Letras E Sons Do Século - Ep. 1
programme.desc: Retrospetiva histórica e documental sobre a Literatura e Música Portuguesa, no Séc. XX, em Portugal. Principais correntes literárias e musicais dos final do século XX.

programme.title: A Rapariga Da Máquina De Filmar
programme.desc: André, documentalista freelancer, depara-se com o caso de uma rapariga que se encontra desaparecida. Elena, uma jovem estudante, de personalidade curiosa tem como hábito fazer-se acompanhar de uma câmara de filmar. Capta compulsivamente imagens do que a rodeia, das pessoas e de si própria. Começando como uma curiosidade, André assiste aos numerosos vídeos que Elena publica online;

programme.title: As Lágrimas Amargas De Petra Von Kant
programme.desc: A história gira em torno de Petra von Kant, uma estilista bem-sucedida que vive fechada no seu apartamento com a assistente Marlene. Debruçada sobre as suas criações e memórias, Petra vive isolada no seu mundo. Karin Thimm é o elemento que falta para a relação claustrofóbica que se vai desenvolver entre as três mulheres. Karin é apresentada por uma amiga a Petra, que se deixa imediatamente fascinar por ela.

programme.title: RTP Brasil - Ep. 10
programme.desc: Programa dedicado à atriz e fadista Dina Teresa (1902-1984), radicada no Brasil há vários anos. Foi escolhida para interpretar o papel de Severa no filme de Leitão de Barros.

programme.title: O Deserto Vermelho
programme.desc: Numa cidade apoderada pela industrialização, Giuliana vive mergulhada num delicado estado emocional. Psicologicamente abatida e insatisfeita, envolve-se com Corrado, um colega do marido. Mas, não consegue apaziguar a sua inquietação. O caso só piora o seu estado depressivo e Giuliana passa a ter uma existência sem propósito, vivendo entre a resignação e a insanidade.

programme.title: Notícias Do Meu País T1 - Ep. 9
programme.desc: Maria Dias saiu de Portugal há mais de 50 anos. Tinha apenas seis anos de idade. Originária de Travassos da Chã, em Trás-os-Montes, a família vivia da agricultura. Chegou o dia em que tiveram de fugir à fome. Os pais largaram tudo e emigraram com cinco filhos para os Estados Unidos. O destino levou-os até Ludlow, no Estado de Massachusetts. Hoje, Maria produz vídeos para as redes sociais com receitas portuguesas.

programme.title: Bem-vindos A Beirais T4 - Ep. 233
programme.desc: No consultório Olga mostra uma notícia de jornal a Nuno. No título da notícia lê-se que mau feitio dá mais anos de vida. Olga quer saber junto de Nuno se pode levar aquela notícia a sério. Nuno diz que pela estatística lhe parece uma análise série. A única subjectividade está em saber o que é mau feitio. Olga diz que mau feitio é as pessoas que dizem a verdade. E que ela diz sempre a verdade aos outros.

programme.title: Os Nossos Dias T2 - Ep. 36
programme.desc: A empregada a quem Teresa pagou para lhe passar informações sobre Alice e Guilherme ouve os dois combinarem uma saída à noite, com o local e hora marcados e logo se apressa a telefonar a Teresa para lhe contar. A rapariga agradece e pede-lhe para que continue atenta. Imediatamente a seguir liga para Sofia a convidá-la para sair.

programme.title: Diário De Maria - Ep. 46

programme.title: Bem-vindos A Beirais T4 - Ep. 96
programme.desc: As sócias comentam a vinda de uma jornalista para uma reportagem com Diogo. Rita defende que a amiga também devia aparecer ao lado do marido, mas Clara faz pouca questão no assunto. Clara só espera que a jornalista fale bem do seu marido já que a reportagem é sobre 'jovens empresários da cidade que vingaram no campo'. No largo da camioneta, Vera aborda Carlos e Nazaré e pergunta-lhes onde fica a casa de Diogo.

programme.title: Visita Guiada T4 - Ep. 7

programme.title: O Sábio - Ep. 111
programme.desc: Todos aguardam a chegada do professor Marco. Telmo é o mais ansioso. Marco chega vestido de marinheiro e Telmo fica encantado com o seu visual. Gabriel desabafa com Rita. Ela tenta que Gabriel compreenda a situação. Telmo convida Marco para jantar. Luís vai até ao Sericaia, mas não consegue encontrar nenhum motivo de envenenamento. Alzira e Raúl contam-lhe que Carmen não comeu nada em exclusivo e não tiveram mais nenhuma queixa.

Uma divertida novela com a direção de Nicolau Breyner, escrita por José Fanha e Jorge Paixão da Costa.

programme.title: Velhos Amigos - Ep. 14
programme.desc: Carlos, enquanto bebe café na tasca da Maria da Assunção, e vê um cartaz afixado na parede de uma concentração de carochas que vai decorrer em Mafra, e combina ir com os amigos. Albertina que está na conversa com Maria da Assunção mete-se com os amigos e pede para ir com eles. Quer aproveitar a boleia para ir visitar a sua irmã, Luísa Maria, que vive em Mafra desde que casou.

programme.title: José Saramago - Levantado Do Chão
programme.desc: Um documentário que retrata o percurso singular do escritor José Saramago, que se afirma 'pessimista pela razão, optimista pela vontade'. Durante quase um ano, uma equipa da RTP reconstitui os pontos cardeais em que a vida e obra de Saramago se fundem,num trabalho que aborda a história do escritor português mais lido e conhecido do mundo.

programme.title: Escrever É Lutar T1 - Ep. 9

Clara só espera que a jornalista fale bem do seu marido já que a reportagem é sobre 'jovens empresários da cidade que vingaram no campo'. No largo da camioneta, Vera aborda Carlos e Nazaré e pergunta-lhes onde fica a casa de Diogo.

Depois fomos até Lisboa, à Mouraria, conhecer a Casa da Severa, um projeto onde se instalou o Restaurante Maria da Mouraria, um espaço que serve de homenagem ao fado e onde a arquitetura se junta à festa.

Apresentam José Luís Porfírio e Rocha de Sousa.

Leonor acaba a relação com Henrique, mas diz-lhe que a amizade eles nunca a vão perder.

programme.title: Bem-vindos A Beirais T4 - Ep. 234
programme.desc: Vasco convida Rita para irem a Paris mas esta diz que não pode ir pois não tem quem fique a tomar conta de Inês, Dinis e Marta. Inês diz que ela consegue tomar conta de Dinis para irem descansados e Rita concorda. Manel entra no minimercado a coçar-se e Tânia também se queixa de comichão. Carlos diz Alzira que devem ter pulgas em casa, parecem borbulhas de pulgas. Alzira ofendida diz que a casa não é nenhum canil.

Na empresa, Emília recusa antecipar o lançamento do catálogo só por causa das peças de Jacinto. Entretanto, Álvaro e Emília aproveitam a boa disposição do filho para lhe dizer que estão muito satisfeitos com Alice porque é muito melhor do que Teresa. Conceição sente uma tontura e é obrigada a sentar-se.

programme.title: Diário De Maria - Ep. 47

Maria tem vinte e sete anos, é solteira e tem raízes pequeno-burguesas. Os seus problemas são os mesmos de qualquer outra mulher em qualquer parte do mundo.

programme.title: Bem-vindos T4 - Ep. 97
programme.desc: Diogo e Ramiro comentam satisfeitos as boas colheitas. Ramiro sugere a Diogo expandir as estufas. Ele adia a decisão e opta por se concentrar nas tarefas imediatas. Rita espanta-se com a precisão da memória de Clara sobre o livro de hóspedes. Mais tarde, na sociedade recreativa, Clara comenta com Diogo o episódio com Rita e diz-lhe que começa a tomar consciência do potencial da sua memória.

programme.title: Guarda-factos Micro

programme.desc: O Mestre Delirante de Guimarães - foi este o nome achado pelos historiadores de arte para identificar o misterioso autor dos inícios do século XVI de que não se conhece nada, a não ser as pinturas que deixou.
